name: Gornelle Beech

official_register.name: Elenco degli alberi monumentali d'Italia (MASAF), sheet 02/H224/RC/18

access: Free. The Sentiero Calabria (Reggio di Calabria to Gambarie stage) crosses the SS 183 at Gornelle and continues through beech woods past the Tre Aie fountain to Piazza Mangeruca, Gambarie.
transport: Gambarie d'Aspromonte (about 1,300 m) is reached by road from Reggio di Calabria; bus link not checked.
verify_notes: Register: MASAF 02/H224/RC/18, 536 cm, 25 m, locality Gornelle. The park-listed trail page puts the official Sentiero Calabria on the SS 183 at Gornelle and in beech woods beyond; it does not name the tree, so the link between trail and tree is by locality only. A search summary (unfetched) also quoted 24 m and 5.36 m; do not rely on it. RECOGNISE: by the Sentiero Calabria at Gornelle near the SS 183 crossing in beech wood; no source describes the trunk. ALIVE: no dated sighting; flag.
hold: cannot be told apart: tied to the Sentiero Calabria by place name only, register point only, in a beech wood

name: Tre Aie Beech

location.address: Localita Tre Aie, Reggio di Calabria (Gambarie)

official_register.name: Elenco degli alberi monumentali d'Italia (MASAF), sheet 03/H224/RC/18

access: Free. Beside the historic Tre Aie fountain on the Sentiero Calabria, about 1.5 to 2 hours there and back from Gambarie (AllTrails listing 'Gambarie - Tre Aie', not fetched).
transport: Walk from Piazza Mangeruca, Gambarie (the trail reaches it past the Tre Aie fountain).
verify_notes: Register: MASAF 03/H224/RC/18, 560 cm, 20 m, locality Tre Aie; same register also lists a stand of silver firs at Tre Aie (01/H224, a group, not delivered). The Parco trail page names the 'historic Tre Aie fountain' on the path into Gambarie; the tree itself is not named by a source. RECOGNISE: near the Tre Aie fountain among beech woods on the Sentiero Calabria. ALIVE: no dated sighting; flag. Twin/neighbour: the Fragolara Corsican pine 05/H224 (38.1505,15.8321) is ~100 m away and was not delivered.
hold: cannot be told apart: tied to the trail by place name only, register point only, in a beech wood
